description: Verify a stock seat cannot create a board category, including through the server action, and that the database is unchanged. Verify a permitted administrator can create it.

Use two clients and multiple boards. Verify the filter and upload pickers return only permitted client, contact and ticket options, fields and totals through normal search and selection. Exercise a portal user as a control.

With shared and unshared projects, authorized and unauthorized tickets, interactions and schedule entries, check All and individual type searches, counts, paging, and field projection. Include a visible child ticket with an inaccessible parent.

Use one create-enabled board, one readable board without create and one excluded board. Compare create, filter and update choices against their respective server policies. Check dependent status and category reads.

For classic and Bento, verify an eligible peer can be assigned and a visible but ineligible MSP participant cannot be selected as an assignee. Confirm permitted mention suggestions and server-side assignment checks.

Check user-selected and default watchers on ticket creation. Confirm unauthorized selections are rejected, restricted email fields are absent from the seat response, and permitted notifications retain their recipients.
Run the representative seat paths without a bundle and with an additional narrowing bundle. Verify existing MSP visibility and loss of access after seat revocation on a fresh request.
